title: Follow-Up: Does Absence of Sandbagging in Gemini 3 Pro Persist Under Anti-Sandbagging Countermeasures?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires designing matched eval-framed vs. non-eval-framed task pairs and running them through Gemini API.
